alignment_policy.candidate_rule: Count a non-identical output-to-GT pair only when every globally minimum-edit alignment consumes the output code point against that same GT code point. Any deletion or competing pair is unresolved; output-only deletion is insertion.
alignment_policy.name: nfc_codepoint_levenshtein_all_optima_conservative_v1

cohort.reviewed_pool_definition: Current scan review DB rows with status=accepted and review_stage=final. They have no historical train/dev allocation, are treated as learning-eligible reviewed GT, and are included after sealed-test ID exclusion.
